thread:
Charlie (PM): Heads-up: ACME and BetaInc announced a public beta for per-tenant routing controls — customers are asking for parity already. Two pilots flagged this as a #1 ask. Need a recommendation by EOD.
Maya (Product): We shouldn't just chase parity. Proposal: ship a compatibility shim for the short term and a clear differentiator after. Example differentiator: cost-aware soft policies and automated fallbacks.
Liam (Eng): Rough engineering notes: shim + API compatibility layer ~2 sprints (including tests + infra). Full tenant-routing (UI, policies, sticky sessions) ~6-8 sprints. Main risk: stateful routing + KV store migration.
Rosa (Design): For a quick ship UX must be simple. Idea: "routing presets" + a single "safeguard mode" toggle. I can produce low-fidelity mocks in ~3 days.
Noah (Sales): Confirming urgency — ACME said they'll pause the pilot if we don't have parity in ~4 weeks. They specifically call out region pinning and named failover. Can product move on a 4-week window?
Charlie (PM): 4 weeks is tight but maybe doable for parity label if we scope carefully. Proposed path: 1) compatibility REST shim that accepts tenant routing headers; 2) backend presets + limited admin UI; 3) canary to one pilot on dedicated capacity; 4) public docs that call out limitations. Parity ship gets us breathing room to build differentiator.
Liam (Eng): Need infra sign-off for reserved capacity and rollout gating. I'll open infra ticket and a migration checklist. Quick note for engineers: temp constraint -> no cross-region sticky sessions in v1. Example shim header prototype: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers: X-Tenant-Routing: "region=us-west;fallback=global"
Body: {"prompt":"..."}
```
This keeps runtime changes minimal.
Maya (Product): Launch criteria (must-have): API spec locked, canary stability to 1 tenant, error rate <0.5% at 95th perc, docs + migration guide published, and design mocks for admin UX. Anything missing is a hard block.
Rosa (Design): Uploaded a placeholder figma: https://figma.com/tenant-routing-v1 (will replace with real frames). I'll add microcopy explaining fallbacks and safeties.
Charlie (PM): OK. @Liam please file the infra ticket and tag eng-oncall. @Noah I'll sync with ACME and set expectations (parity label + roadmap for differentiator). Reconvene tomorrow 10:00am for final scope lock. :thumbsup: 
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: routing-shim/v0.1 -> canary at 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z :rocket:
Noah (Sales): Thanks — I'll tell ACME we can aim for a limited parity ship and outline the follow-up differentiator plan.
Charlie (PM): Great. Saving notes and linking this thread to the roadmap card.
